senses.gloss: f. (עָצַב, v. אֲבִרְזִין) fur trimmed (or to be trimmed) of its ends, robe, cover.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:7">Kel. XXVI, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 66b">B. Kam. 66ᵇ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>עיצ׳</he>).
Ib. ע׳ אינה צריכה קיצוע an ‘utsba requires no trimming (in order to be considered a finished object of use).

<cite ref="Zevachim 94a:4">Zeb. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ שחשב עליה לקצעה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ליה</he>, corr. acc.) a fur which the owner had intented to trim; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 10</cite> <he>עוצבה</he> R. S. to Kel. l. c. (ed. <he>אצבע</he>, corr. acc.); Zeb. l. c. <he>ע׳ דחשיב עלה וכ׳</he>.
